simulator.note: Like the 1.3.4 X110p image, its bootloader header has byte 0x43 = 0x80 (the EuP standby-on-AC-power-up flag, bypassed by $fp = 0xDEADBEAD in M3602.start()).  During startup (0x8000D658..0x8000D704), the application calls 0x8014583C(0), which writes [0x00, 0x38, 0x00] to the Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x63 on SCB0; without a tuner at 0x63 it retried 4 times and called 0x80000674(0, 0) to shut down into standby.  With the AV2011 model attached at 0x63 (tuners.py, device.tunerModel), the tuner initializes its 42 registers and acknowledges the check, and the application opens its main menu (panel " ON ", "noCH", ~481k non-background pixels at 80 M instructions).  Unlike the later SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo builds, this early Libcore 4.7.0 build uses the IR coding "necfirst" (scan_code_to_msg_code at 0x8000B594 shifts by 0x18: MENU 0x02FD, OK 0x024F, DOWN 0x028F), while key_get_key at 0x8001C360 checks (code & 0xFFFF0000) == 0x02370000 (extended NEC address bytes 0x40, 0xEC).

desc: An early 1.0.11C MCAS+EMU update (2011-07-15) for the Opticum HD X110p satellite receiver on the ALi M3606 SoC, built on Libcore 4.7.0 (2011-05-12) and the M3606_DVBS2_SABBAT_20110413 application branch.

Its NIM attach function (0x80028A00) pairs the internal S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator with an Airoha AV2011 silicon tuner at 8-bit I2C address 0xC6 (7-bit 0x63) on SCB0 (init 0x8014527C, control 0x80145318, status 0x80145800), and its startup verifies that the AV2011 acknowledges a 2-register write at 0x63 before opening the UI.
